name: Nemesgörzsöny (Hungary)
description: White field with a black serrated stripe at the hoist edge and a fly panel of red and green interlocking triangles, charged at the centre of the white with the municipal arms of Nemesgörzsöny (a crowned red and white shield with a wheel and a helm, within a green wreath) above the name Nemesgörzsöny.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Nemesgörzsöny arms with crown, helm and wreath
